lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: cleanup of watchtower 4's warehouse is complete.
Very good.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: During the cleanup, I found something rather unusual.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: May I ask you to examine it?
Again...?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If you're busy,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I can always have Rapi examine it.
Don't do that.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Then allow me to give my report.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: The object consists of a single board and small circular-shaped pieces

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: which are spread evenly across the length of the board.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Engraved upon these pieces is unfamiliar text.
Any idea what it could be?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Perhaps runes, or some kind of cipher.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: At this juncture, it's hard to determine with any certainty.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: There are pairs of different colored symbols.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: My guess is that it might be an encoded message left by the Raptures.
You can rest easy, Delta.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: How so?
It's an old game called janggi.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I've never heard of it.
The pieces represent people of different ranks such as soldier and king.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Okay.
Players utilize various tactics and strategies to defeat their opponent's king.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: This game sounds very interesting.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: In fact, it sounds something like a battle.
If you're interested, I can put you in charge of this janggi game.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'd like that!
Your first order of business is to continue your research, along with Signal.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Is that all right?
Yes, you have my permission. I hope to see positive results from you two.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'm sure Signal and I

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: will be able to turn up something.
